```{r setup}
source("utils.R")
source("config_load.R")

PARADIGM    <- "active"
DATE_SOURCE <- "20261016"
DATE_STR    <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")

DPRIME_COL_WITH    <- "d_withnovels"
DPRIME_COL_WITHOUT <- "d_nonovels"
CONDITIONS         <- c("Simple", "Complex")

STUDY          <- "Active"
DATA_ROOT      <- glue("L:/EEG_Flow_data/Study_EEG_Flow_{STUDY}/derivatives_v2/outputs/measures/behavior/")
OUTPUT_RESULTS <- glue("L:/EEG_Flow_data/Study_EEG_Flow_{STUDY}/derivatives_v2/outputs/stats/load/behavior/")

dir.create(OUTPUT_RESULTS, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

included_participants <- INCLUDED_ACTIVE
n <- length(included_participants)

load_and_filter <- function(fname) {
  read.csv(file.path(DATA_ROOT, fname)) %>%
    filter(participant %in% included_participants) %>%
    rename(Participant = participant, Condition = condition)
}

df_rt     <- load_and_filter(glue("{DATE_SOURCE}_active_oddball_rt_load.csv"))
df_dprime <- load_and_filter(glue("{DATE_SOURCE}_active_oddball_dprime_load.csv"))
df_errors <- load_and_filter(glue("{DATE_SOURCE}_active_oddball_errors_load.csv"))

df_dprime_with    <- df_dprime %>% rename(dprime = all_of(DPRIME_COL_WITH))
df_dprime_without <- df_dprime %>% rename(dprime = all_of(DPRIME_COL_WITHOUT))

for (df in list(df_rt, df_dprime, df_errors)) {
  cat("N:", n_distinct(df$Participant), "| Conditions:", paste(sort(unique(df$Condition)), collapse=", "), "\n")
}
```

## Overview

```{r overview}
cat(glue(
"**Paper**: LOAD — Oddball Response
**Paradigm**: ACTIVE
**Conditions**: {paste(CONDITIONS, collapse = ' vs ')}
**N participants**: {n}
**Rendered**: {DATE_STR}
"))
```

```{r helper}
run_ttest_behav <- function(df, dv, dv_label, conditions, label_suffix) {
  cat(glue("\n### {dv_label}\n\n"))

  df_filtered <- df %>%
    filter(Condition %in% conditions) %>%
    mutate(Condition = factor(Condition, levels = conditions)) %>%
    select(Participant, Condition, value = all_of(dv))

  df_wide <- df_filtered %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = Participant, names_from = Condition, values_from = value) %>%
    drop_na(all_of(conditions))

  if (nrow(df_wide) < 3) {
    cat(glue("> Warning: not enough data for {dv_label}\n\n"))
    return(NULL)
  }

  col_a <- conditions[1]; col_b <- conditions[2]
  df_wide <- df_wide %>% mutate(dif = .data[[col_a]] - .data[[col_b]])
  n_valid <- nrow(df_wide)

  shapiro <- shapiro.test(df_wide$dif)

  t_res <- t.test(df_wide[[col_a]], df_wide[[col_b]], paired = TRUE)
  d_res <- df_filtered %>% cohens_d(value ~ Condition, paired = TRUE)

  bf_res <- ttestBF(x = df_wide[[col_a]], y = df_wide[[col_b]], paired = TRUE)
  bf10   <- as.numeric(extractBF(bf_res)$bf)
  bf01   <- 1 / bf10

  summary_stats <- df_filtered %>%
    group_by(Condition) %>%
    summarise(M = round(mean(value, na.rm=TRUE), 2),
              SD = round(sd(value, na.rm=TRUE), 2), .groups="drop")

  means <- setNames(summary_stats$M,  summary_stats$Condition)
  sds   <- setNames(summary_stats$SD, summary_stats$Condition)

  t_val  <- round(t_res$statistic, 2)
  df_val <- t_res$parameter
  p_val  <- t_res$p.value
  p_str  <- format_p(p_val)
  d_val  <- round(abs(d_res$effsize), 2)
  d_mag  <- interpret_d(d_val)

  apa <- glue(
    "{dv_label}: {conditions[1]} (M = {means[conditions[1]]}, SD = {sds[conditions[1]]}) vs. ",
    "{conditions[2]} (M = {means[conditions[2]]}, SD = {sds[conditions[2]]}); ",
    "t({df_val}) = {t_val}, {p_str}, d = {d_val} ({d_mag}), BF10 = {format_bf(bf10)}."
  )

  cat(glue("N = {n_valid} | Shapiro-Wilk: W = {round(shapiro$statistic, 3)}, p = {round(shapiro$p.value, 3)}\n\n"))
  cat(glue("**APA:** {apa}\n\n"))

  list(
    summary = tibble(
      Measure = dv_label,
      !!glue("Mean_{conditions[1]}") := means[conditions[1]],
      !!glue("SD_{conditions[1]}")   := sds[conditions[1]],
      !!glue("Mean_{conditions[2]}") := means[conditions[2]],
      !!glue("SD_{conditions[2]}")   := sds[conditions[2]],
      t = t_val, df = df_val, p = p_val, p_str = p_str,
      d = d_val, d_magnitude = d_mag,
      BF10 = round(bf10, 2), BF01 = round(bf01, 2)
    ),
    apa = apa
  )
}
```

## Behavioral measures — with novels

```{r rt, results='asis'}
summary_rows <- list()
apa_texts    <- list()

res <- run_ttest_behav(df_rt, "rt_mean", "Reaction Time (ms)", CONDITIONS, "load_rt")
if (!is.null(res)) { summary_rows[["rt"]] <- res$summary; apa_texts[["rt"]] <- res$apa }
```

```{r cv, results='asis'}
res <- run_ttest_behav(df_rt, "rt_cv", "Coefficient of Variation RT (%)", CONDITIONS, "load_cv")
if (!is.null(res)) { summary_rows[["cv"]] <- res$summary; apa_texts[["cv"]] <- res$apa }
```

```{r dprime-with, results='asis'}
res <- run_ttest_behav(df_dprime_with, "dprime", "d-prime (with novels)", CONDITIONS, "load_dprime_with")
if (!is.null(res)) { summary_rows[["dprime_with"]] <- res$summary; apa_texts[["dprime_with"]] <- res$apa }
```

```{r errors-with, results='asis'}
res <- run_ttest_behav(df_errors, "pct_errors", "Errors % (with novels)", CONDITIONS, "load_errors_with")
if (!is.null(res)) { summary_rows[["errors_with"]] <- res$summary; apa_texts[["errors_with"]] <- res$apa }
```

## Behavioral measures — without novels

```{r dprime-without, results='asis'}
res <- run_ttest_behav(df_dprime_without, "dprime", "d-prime (without novels)", CONDITIONS, "load_dprime_without")
if (!is.null(res)) { summary_rows[["dprime_without"]] <- res$summary; apa_texts[["dprime_without"]] <- res$apa }
```

```{r errors-without, results='asis'}
res <- run_ttest_behav(df_errors, "pct_errors_nonovels", "Errors % (without novels)", CONDITIONS, "load_errors_without")
if (!is.null(res)) { summary_rows[["errors_without"]] <- res$summary; apa_texts[["errors_without"]] <- res$apa }
```

summary_df <- bind_rows(summary_rows)
knitr::kable(summary_df, digits=3, caption = "LOAD | ACTIVE | Oddball Response")
